name: triage_close_if_false_positive
why: The triage-then-act request as one turn: the analyst asks for a verdict and, if it is a false positive, a close for approval.

Proves the effect, not the card: the arc approves the close, then the writable fixture box is read back and the alert must hold status Closed with a closure reason and notes, its other fields untouched (the old live-writes row of the same name, converted).
Also grades the two record-write defects a fixture reproduces: the saved record must hold exactly what the model's call sent, and the update card must name the record and each field's current value.

steps.user: Triage this alert and give me your verdict. If it is a false positive, close it with the right closure reason for my approval.
